name: Úrhida (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of yellow over red, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Úrhida (a red oval with a bunch of grapes and a pruning knife within a yellow frame) above the name ÚRHIDA in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Úrhida arms in a yellow frame
